text: The service was terrible. The woman issuing the cards spoke rudely. When I asked for information, she brushed me off, telling me to ask someone inside, as if she didn't work there. Even when I asked inside, they spoke politely. It was as if the staff lacked education. Even the cleaning staff were more polite. The nurse was also sarcastic when I asked a question. It wasn't even that busy at the time; I was there during the evening special opening hours. Improvements are needed. I'm very confused about how they treat the public. I paid for the service myself, not using any benefits, and I couldn't even get a medical certificate. One visit is enough.
